title: Review the software design to verify compliance with security requirements and risk information
reason: The design of every active component of the architecture (the eleven ARC components) is checked against the security requirements and risks in its threat model, and a model turns suspect when its element changes. An automated review in the toolchain (PW.2.1's second option) runs in the security test: every threat model models an active element, covers the six STRIDE categories, and every mitigation resolves to an object or a file that exists. Partial: that review checks the models' structure and references, not whether their threats are complete. The eleven models were reviewed by an independent reviewer agent (D-333) on 2026-11-19, each review recorded in the model with its findings and their dispositions: eight are reviewed. THREAT-gate, THREAT-config and THREAT-planning stay written: their open findings (VULN-gate-check-source, VULN-gate-judged-by-own-head, the gate-change rule's reach) were fixed or accepted with their reason by the authoring session on 2026-11-19, which changed the models, so each awaits an independent re-review (D-333) before it counts as reviewed.
